title: Mixed Event — Relaxing Tea Time — Episode5 Doing Our Homework!

meta.Event Outline: In the lead-up to White Day, Kanade begins thinking about how to express her gratitude for the Valentine's chocolate she received, as well as for all the help she's been given. As she's struggling to think of gifts, she learns that Ichika is having the same dilemma, and the two team up!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you as well. But I am starting to feel the fatigue of walking around all day...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Still, I'm glad we did this.
Hanasato and the others helped us realize something important.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We need to learn more about the people we're giving our gifts to. It's simple, but really important.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, and I plan on doing research on everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
How do we actually do research on them?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How? Well, we could ask them...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, wait... Then they'll know that we're looking to get them gifts.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think so, because then they'll just say that anything will be fine...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We might need to subtly ask during our regular conversations what they'd really enjoy receiving or if anything has been on their minds lately...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know. I'm also not very good at these sorts of things...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually... In that case, why don't we work together?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We could exchange any information we come across. For example, I could tell you about anything that Honami tells me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I have to ask them what they want...
But subtly... Discreetly...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, Yuki, about the lyrics for this part...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, she's taking a nap right now, but she should be back soon...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, in that case, I think I'll also take a quick break. I'm feeling kinda tired...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <U-Um, Enanan? Has anything been on your mind lately...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? Where's this coming from all of a sudden?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, it's just... I wanted to make some small talk... So, has anything been on your mind?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <S-Small talk...? It's pretty rare of you to want to, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, uh... Y-You think so? I don't think it's odd for me to...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<So, has anything been on my mind lately?
Hmm... Well...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I guess I haven't been getting all that much sleep...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, because of this thing I've been working on for my art class. I've been having trouble sleeping since I'm constantly thinking about it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I see... You'd like to sleep better...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. Thank you for telling me, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <N-Nothing... I was honestly just wondering how things have been for you lately.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Really? K, you hardly ever try to make small talk with anyone...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, let's just say K wanted to ask how you were for a change. So, with that in mind, aren't you gonna ask me?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <U-Uh, yes... I'd like to ask you as well, Amia. Has anything been on your mind lately...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I've been staring at so many flickering effects lately that my eyes are sorta starting to get really tired.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I see. Your eyes are tired... Got it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Thank goodness I got a chance to ask them...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It just needs to stew for a little bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Now I have to discreetly ask Ms. Mochizuki...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Next, we'll... Huh?
Is something wrong, Ms. Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh?! Oh, um...
Actually, there's something I'd like to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um... Has anything been on your mind lately?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What? Why this all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
N-No reason.
I was just hoping to make some small talk is all...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Well, my shoulders are a little sore...
Possibly because my band's been practicing more recently.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your shoulders are sore...? I see. That must be painful...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hello, Hanasato? I'm sorry for calling so suddenly.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<That's okay!
I was a little surprised to see it was you, but how can I help?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
So, uhh...
How have things been for you lately...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <How have things been? Oh, is this a part of your research?! Thanks for taking the time to ask me!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, has anything been on your mind...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Hmm... Well...
It's a good thing, but we've been really busy, and...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? You've also finished asking everyone, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Yes, I think I managed to ask the others how they've been doing lately without blowing my cover.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Aside from Hanasato and Momoi, I was also able to ask everyone without being found out.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<That's great...!
Thank goodness we were both able to manage it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, let me tell you what I learned.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think that's about it for me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<I see...
Thank you so much. This helps a lot.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Then, let's both do our best to get the perfect gifts for everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Now, last but not least...
I'll go over to ask them.
